summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin handles the setup and management of staff administration pages, including user session management, site dropdowns, discipline dropdowns, and employment application lists.
purpose: To provide a user interface for staff administrators to manage employment applications and site discipline selections.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: TextBox control for inputting the start date of employment applications.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: TextBox control for inputting the end date of employment applications.

fields.name: ddSite
fields.description: DropDownList control for selecting a site.

fields.name: ddDiscipline
fields.description: DropDownList control for selecting a discipline.

workflows.name: Employment Application Management
steps: Input date range using txtStartDate and txtEndDate.

validations.name: Date Validation
validations.description: Ensure that the end date is not earlier than the start date using CustomValidator cvrEndDateAfter.
